book.title: Rome Paul Ana Fef Rome Isah

content: Sabuw Fairih Naatu Ririmih
Yait ana baitumatum erara’iy ana merar kwanay kwanab a kou’ayamaim narun, baise men i ana kakafin isan bairi kwanagam kwanibabatiy.
Sabuw afa tebitumatum bay etei karam boro hinaa, baise afa hai baitumatum kikimin, imih i bay akisinamo te’aau.

O yait bay etei ku’aa, taituwa bay afa men eaa isan inanufuruw ina’omih, na’atube o yait bay afa ihamiyen afa’awat ku’aa, men taituwa bay etei eaa isan inanufuruw ina’omih. Anayabin God nati orot auman ibasit ebaib.

Kwa men karam orot ta ana akirwairafin kwanibabatiyimih? Orot Ukwarin akisinamo boro ana akir wairafih ta ere’ere naatu ta ebatabat boro hairi nibatiyih. Naatu Regah akisin boro nafufunih yait i bowabow gewas ebowabow.
Orot ta enotanot veya ta’imon i veya gagamin, men veya afa na’atube. Naatu orot ta enotanot veya etei hai itinin i ta’imon. Orot ta’ita’imon i taiyuwih hinanot gewas hinabow.

Orot yait not veya ta’imon ya’asair imaim God ekwakwafir, i narusagiy. Naatu o yait a kok bay ta ta ku’aa i auman Regah kururusagiy, anayabin nati bay isan Regah ifefeyan igegewasinika. Naatu o yait sawar afa itafuta afa’awat ku’aau auman Regah kururusagiy, naatu merarayow kubitin.
Yawasit tama’am o tamomorob i men it taiyuwit isat.
Imih yawasit tama’am i Regah isan tama’am, naatu tamomorob, i Regah isan tamomorob. Yawasit tama’am o tamomorob it i Regah nowan.
Ana’an iti isan Keriso morob naatu yawasin misir maiye, naatu sabuw yawayawasih, murumurubih etei isah ebi’aiwob.
Aisim taituwa bayuwat eani’aan kwabibabatiyih? Naatu aisim taituwa kwanunufuruwih? Anayabin it etei boro God ana baibatiyen urama’ama nanamaim tanabat nibabatiyit.
Bukamaim hikikirum,

content.text: “Ayu yawasu ama’am, sabuw etei boro nou’umaim suh hinayowen hinakwafiru;
naatu sabuw tutufin etei boro hinaorereb ayu i God.”

content: Isan imih it ta’ita’imon ata yawas abisa tasisinaf etei boro God ana tur tana’owen.
Isan imih taituwat bairi men taiyuwit ata baitumatum nena tanafufunen tanigamigamimih. Naatu ata not tanarumutufur taituwat men tanikubibiruwih hai baitumatum nare’emih.
Regah Jesu wanawananamaim God isou sinaf irerereb asoso’ob i iti, sawar etei i gewasih bay isan. Baise orot yait nanot bay afa nabitafutaf na’at, nati bay i orot ana tafutaf matar imih men naa.
Baise o a bay ku’aa’umaim taituwa iu yababan kubitin, o i men yabow ana efamaim kusisinaf. Imih men a bay ku’aa’umaim taituwa ana not inikwaris, anayabin Keriso nati orot auman isan morob.
Naatu men iniwa’an abisa o gewasin irouw kunotanot nabotabir kakafin namatar isan hinao’omih.
Anayabin God ana aiwob wanawanan atomamaim i men an gagamin, baise an gagamin i a ef namutufor, tufuw, yasisir Anun kakafiyinane kwanab kwanama.
Anayabin orot yait Keriso isan iti na’atube ebowabow God i ebiyasisir naatu sabuw nati orot ana bowabow isan boro hinakakafiy.
Nati isan it ta’ita’imon tanibaibaisbonen koufair tanab not ta’imon tanabow tufuw namatar, ayubit tanawowab nayen nara’at.
Men aatomamaim naatu bayumaim God ana bowabow tanagurusimih, bay etei i gewasih men tafutafumih. Baise ana kakafin i men abisa o ku’ani’aan imaim inasinaf orot babin ta ana not inikwarisimih.
Ana gewasin finimih men kwanaa naatu wine men kwanatom, o sawar afa kwanasinaf taituwa hai not kwanikwarisimih.
Imih sawar abisa’awat isah o kubitumatum nati i o God airi a founamaim nama. Naatu iso’ob abisa kusisinaf i men erekasiy auman kusisinaf o i boro baigegewasin inab.
Baise orot yait erekasiy auman naa natomatom na’at baibatiyen boro nab anayabin i taiyuwin ana baitumatum ebigigim. Naatu abisa men baitumatumamaim kusisinaf i bowabow kakafin.
